tweets: Shipping a small feature today: deleted 200 lines, added 20. The codebase feels lighter already.
Layover in Lisbon, watching the trams climb the hills. Slow travel beats rushing every time.
Made shakshuka for brunch and finally got the eggs just right. Smoked paprika is non-negotiable.
TIL tardigrades have survived all five mass extinctions. Nature's ultimate backup strategy.
Spent the morning at the gallery staring at one Rothko. No photo does the color justice.
Sunday league final went to penalties. I missed mine and we still won. Football is chaos.
Learning fingerstyle guitar: my calluses are back and my neighbors are patient saints.
Rereading The Left Hand of Darkness. Le Guin builds worlds with half the words others need.
The new sci-fi short I watched uses practical effects. Miniatures still beat CGI for soul.
Finished a cozy farming sim after 60 hours. My virtual turnips thrived; my sleep schedule didn't.
Sourdough attempt #12 finally has an open crumb. The starter has earned its name: Doughbi-Wan.
Ran 10k without stopping for the first time. Slow pace, big grin, sore everything.
Golden hour on film hits different. 36 exposures, zero previews, pure patience.
Planted herbs on the balcony: basil, mint, and one very optimistic tomato seedling.
The ISS just passed overhead and I waved like it could see me. No regrets.
Visited the old town archive today. Handwritten letters from 1890 read like group chats.
Maybe happiness is just a well-defined problem and a quiet afternoon to solve it.
Remote work win: deep focus before noon, long walk after. Meetings can wait.
Third espresso of the day. Productivity is a wave and I am surfing it.
Night bus through the city, rain on the windows, playlist on shuffle. Perfect ending.
